L01_female.wav.speaker: female
L01_female.wav.text: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the central station?

L02_male.wav.speaker: male
L02_male.wav.text: Sure, it is not far from here at all.

L03_male.wav.speaker: male
L03_male.wav.text: Just walk straight down this street for two blocks.

L04_female.wav.speaker: female
L04_female.wav.text: Okay, and what should I do after that?

L05_male.wav.speaker: male
L05_male.wav.text: Turn right at the big convenience store on the corner.

L06_female.wav.speaker: female
L06_female.wav.text: Turn right at the store, got it.

L07_male.wav.speaker: male
L07_male.wav.text: You will see a large glass building in front of you.

L08_female.wav.speaker: female
L08_female.wav.text: How long will it take on foot?

L09_male.wav.speaker: male
L09_male.wav.text: It will take about ten minutes to walk there.

L10_female.wav.speaker: female
L10_female.wav.text: That sounds easy enough, thank you so much for your help!
